prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon preparation with carbohydrate loading and hydration strategy for high-endurance training

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 55-65% of total intake
Includes specific hydration strategy with fluid intake recommendations throughout the day
Covers all three meals plus snacks in a single day format
All meals and snacks are practical and realistically consumable by an athlete
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and hydration strategy

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and increase strength through weightlifting training

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers one full day with at least 4 meals/snacks
Includes pre-workout and post-workout meals with appropriate timing
Provides minimum 2.0g protein per kg bodyweight (170g total)
Maintains balanced macronutrient distribution supporting strength training goals
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-based athlete (weightlifter) requiring balanced macros with high protein intake and specific meal timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Pre-match fueling and recovery for soccer competition
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Vegetarian, no dairy 2 hours before match

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 3 meals that are compact and easily digestible
All meals are vegetarian and comply with dairy timing restriction
Meals are appropriately timed around soccer competition and include carbohydrates for energy and protein for recovery
